title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Payment Election Lead Time
content:
The election lead time of a payment method election on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record is the program's payment method change lead time, in business days.

## Counting

- Business days run Monday through Friday and exclude Lakeland state holidays.
- The count starts with the business day after the day the election is recorded.
- The payment method effective date is the business day on which the count reaches the election lead time; payments issued on or after it use the elected method.

## Worked examples (hypothetical dates, no state holiday in the span, a lead time of 2 business days)

| Day the election is recorded | Business days counted | Payment method effective date |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday | Thursday (1), Friday (2) | Friday |
| Thursday | Friday (1), Monday (2) | Monday |
| Friday | Monday (1), Tuesday (2) | Tuesday |

A payment issued on the Thursday in the first row still uses the method in force before the election; a payment issued on the Friday uses the elected method.
